goal: kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv gains at least ten rows on coordination whose expect_paths is coordination.md; rag.py pack --root _self gives coverage good with a coordination.md line for each of the twelve questions in this item's first check; the _self lookup eval passes

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import pathlib, subprocess, re, csv
qs = ['how does an agent message another running session', 'what does coord.py claim and lease do', 'how do agents avoid duplicate research with coord dedup', 'how to run coord.py serve for several operators', 'what does the coord hook show at session start', 'how do I tell a running sprint runner to add scope', 'why did claims stay 0 in the benchmark', "how do I let another operator's agents see my claims", 'how are the kb MCP coord tools turned on', 'which coord records does tidy check before it removes a worktree', 'what does coord do differently on Windows', 'how do I see a stuck coord claim or a failed ask in kbmon']
bad = []
for q in qs:
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', '--root', '_self', q, '--budget', '400'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    o = r.stdout
    h = o.splitlines()[0] if o else ''
    if r.returncode != 0 or not h.startswith('coverage: good') or 'coordination.md:' not in o:
        bad.append((q, r.returncode, h[:90]))
for b in bad: print('miss:', b)
assert not bad, f'{len(bad)} of {len(qs)} questions not good from coordination.md'
print('ok', len(qs))
